```{r}
  "pass", "verbal", "timed", "test_type", "score_type",

# Convert to data frame for easy lookup
scale_metadata <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(cvlt3_brief_scale_data, as.data.frame))

# Predefined areas for CVLT-3 Brief Core Score Summary page
# Format: c(top, left, bottom, right) in points
# These need calibration for your PDF format
areas_core_page <- list(
  learning = c(166, 52, 265, 560),      # Immediate Recall: Trial 1-4
  delayed = c(289, 52, 365, 560),       # Delayed Recall section
  recognition = c(397, 52, 500, 560),   # Yes/No Recognition section
  intrusions = c(520, 52, 560, 560),    # Recall Errors section
  forced_choice = c(580, 52, 620, 560)  # Forced Choice section
)

areas_index_page <- list(
  trials_total = c(159, 52, 210, 560)   # Standard Score Summary - Trials 1-4 row
)

areas_process_page <- list(
  repetitions = c(230, 52, 280, 560)    # Repetition Errors section
)
```

## CVLT-3 Brief Score Extractor

Extracts 15 specific scales in exact order matching your data format.

**Tables from Core Score Summary (page 3):**
- Learning Trials (4 scales), Delayed Recall (3), Recognition (4), Intrusions (1), Forced-Choice (1)

**From Standard Score Summary (page 7):**
- Trials 1-4 Correct (index score)

**From Process Score Summary (page 9):**
- Total Repetitions

---

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload CVLT-3 Brief PDF", accept = ".pdf")

hr()
h5("Page Numbers")
helpText("Adjust based on your PDF (if embedded in larger report)")

numericInput("page_core", "Core Score Summary:", value = 3, min = 1, max = 100)
numericInput("page_index", "Standard Score Summary:", value = 7, min = 1, max = 100)
numericInput("page_process", "Process Score Summary:", value = 9, min = 1, max = 100)

hr()
selectInput("method", "Extraction Method", choices = c("stream", "lattice"), selected = "stream")
checkboxInput("use_areas", "Use predefined areas", value = FALSE)

hr()
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract All Tables", class = "btn-success btn-lg")
downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV", class = "btn-primary")
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_numeric <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

# Storage
rv <- reactiveValues(
  raw_core = NULL,
  raw_index = NULL,
  raw_process = NULL,
  final_data = NULL
)

# Extract all pages
observeEvent(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)
  
  withProgress(message = "Extracting tables...", value = 0, {
    
    # Extract Core Score Summary page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Core page...")
    tryCatch({
      if (input$use_areas) {
        # Use areas (may need calibration)
        result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          file = input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$page_core,
          method = input$method,
          output = "matrix"
        )
      } else {
        result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          file = input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$page_core,
          method = input$method,
          output = "matrix"
        )
      }
      
      if (length(result) > 0) {
        combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(result, function(m) {
          df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
          df
        }))
        colnames(combined) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(combined)))
        rv$raw_core <- combined
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Core page error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
    
    # Extract Standard Score Summary page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Index page...")
    tryCatch({
      result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$page_index,
        method = input$method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
      
      if (length(result) > 0) {
        combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(result, function(m) {
          df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
          df
        }))
        colnames(combined) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(combined)))
        rv$raw_index <- combined
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Index page error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
    
    # Extract Process Score Summary page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Process page...")
    tryCatch({
      result <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
        file = input$file$datapath,
        pages = input$page_process,
        method = input$method,
        output = "matrix"
      )
      
      if (length(result) > 0) {
        combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(result, function(m) {
          df <- as.data.frame(m, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
          df[] <- lapply(df, trimws)
          df
        }))
        colnames(combined) <- paste0("V", seq_len(ncol(combined)))
        rv$raw_process <- combined
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      showNotification(paste("Process page error:", e$message), type = "error")
    })
    
    incProgress(0.1, detail = "Done")
  })
})

output$raw_core <- renderDT({
  req(rv$raw_core)
  datatable(rv$raw_core, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20))
})

output$raw_index <- renderDT({
  req(rv$raw_index)
  datatable(rv$raw_index, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

output$raw_process <- renderDT({
  req(rv$raw_process)
  datatable(rv$raw_process, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 10))
})

# Mapping UI
output$mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(rv$raw_core)
  
  core_cols <- colnames(rv$raw_core)
  index_cols <- if (!is.null(rv$raw_index)) colnames(rv$raw_index) else core_cols
  process_cols <- if (!is.null(rv$raw_process)) colnames(rv$raw_process) else core_cols
  
  make_choices <- function(cols, df) {
    if (is.null(df)) return(c("None" = "None"))
    setNames(cols, sapply(cols, function(c) {
      preview <- paste(head(na.omit(df[[c]]), 3), collapse=", ")
      paste0(c, " [", substr(preview, 1, 50), "]")
    }))
  }
  
  core_choices <- make_choices(core_cols, rv$raw_core)
  index_choices <- make_choices(index_cols, rv$raw_index)
  process_choices <- make_choices(process_cols, rv$raw_process)
  none <- c("None" = "None")
  
  wellPanel(
    h4("Core Score Summary Columns"),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("core_scale", "Scale:", choices = core_choices, selected = core_cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = core_choices, selected = if(length(core_cols)>=2) core_cols[2] else core_cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_score", "Scaled Score:", choices = core_choices, selected = if(length(core_cols)>=3) core_cols[3] else core_cols[1])),
      column(3, selectInput("core_pct", "Percentile:", choices = core_choices, selected = if(length(core_cols)>=4) core_cols[4] else core_cols[1]))
    ),
    helpText("Row ranges for Core page (adjust based on raw data preview):"),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, numericInput("row_learn_start", "Learning start:", value = 2, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("row_delayed_start", "Delayed start:", value = 7, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("row_recog_start", "Recognition start:", value = 11, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("row_intrus_start", "Intrusions start:", value = 16, min = 1))
    ),
    numericInput("row_forced_start", "Forced-Choice start:", value = 18, min = 1),
    
    hr(),
    h4("Standard Score Summary Columns"),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("index_scale", "Scale:", choices = c(none, index_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("index_raw", "Sum Scaled:", choices = c(none, index_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("index_score", "Index Score:", choices = c(none, index_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("index_pct", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, index_choices)))
    ),
    numericInput("row_trials_total", "Trials 1-4 Correct row:", value = 2, min = 1),
    
    hr(),
    h4("Process Score Summary Columns"),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, selectInput("proc_scale", "Scale:", choices = c(none, process_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("proc_raw", "Raw Score:", choices = c(none, process_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("proc_score", "Scaled Score:", choices = c(none, process_choices))),
      column(3, selectInput("proc_pct", "Percentile:", choices = c(none, process_choices)))
    ),
    numericInput("row_rep_start", "Repetitions row:", value = 5, min = 1),
    
    hr(),
    actionButton("process_btn", "Process Data", class = "btn-warning btn-lg")
  )
})

# Process and build final data
observeEvent(input$process_btn, {
  req(rv$raw_core)
  
  core <- rv$raw_core
  idx <- rv$raw_index
  proc <- rv$raw_process
  
  results <- list()
  
  # Helper to extract row
  get_row <- function(df, row_num, col_raw, col_score, col_pct) {
    if (is.null(df) || row_num > nrow(df)) return(list(raw = NA, score = NA, pct = NA))
    list(
      raw = safe_numeric(df[[col_raw]][row_num]),
      score = safe_numeric(df[[col_score]][row_num]),
      pct = safe_numeric(df[[col_pct]][row_num])
    )
  }
  
  # 1. Trial 1-4 Correct (rows from core page)
  for (i in 1:4) {
    row_num <- input$row_learn_start + i - 1
    vals <- get_row(core, row_num, input$core_raw, input$core_score, input$core_pct)
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
      scale = paste0("Trial ", i, " Correct"),
      raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
    )
  }
  
  # 2. Trials 1-4 Correct (index score from index page)
  if (!is.null(idx) && input$index_score != "None") {
    vals <- get_row(idx, input$row_trials_total, input$index_raw, input$index_score, input$index_pct)
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
      scale = "Trials 1-4 Correct",
      raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
    )
  }
  
  # 3. Delayed Recall (3 rows)
  delayed_scales <- c("Short Delay Free Recall", "Long Delay Free Recall", "Long Delay Cued Recall")
  for (i in 1:3) {
    row_num <- input$row_delayed_start + i - 1
    vals <- get_row(core, row_num, input$core_raw, input$core_score, input$core_pct)
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
      scale = delayed_scales[i],
      raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
    )
  }
  
  # 4. Recognition (4 rows)
  recog_scales <- c("Total Hits", "Total False Positives", "Recognition Discriminability (d')", "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric")
  for (i in 1:4) {
    row_num <- input$row_recog_start + i - 1
    vals <- get_row(core, row_num, input$core_raw, input$core_score, input$core_pct)
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
      scale = recog_scales[i],
      raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
    )
  }
  
  # 5. Intrusions (1 row)
  vals <- get_row(core, input$row_intrus_start, input$core_raw, input$core_score, input$core_pct)
  results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
    scale = "CVLT-3 Total Intrusions",
    raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
  )
  
  # 6. Repetitions (from process page)
  if (!is.null(proc) && input$proc_score != "None") {
    vals <- get_row(proc, input$row_rep_start, input$proc_raw, input$proc_score, input$proc_pct)
    results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
      scale = "CVLT-3 Total Repetitions",
      raw_score = vals$raw, score = vals$score, percentile = vals$pct
    )
  }
  
  # 7. Forced-Choice (raw score only)
  vals <- get_row(core, input$row_forced_start, input$core_raw, input$core_score, input$core_pct)
  results[[length(results) + 1]] <- list(
    scale = "CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits",
    raw_score = vals$raw, score = NA, percentile = 50
  )
  
  # Combine results
  df <- dplyr::bind_rows(results)
  
  # Join with metadata
  final <- df |>
    dplyr::left_join(scale_metadata, by = "scale") |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      test = "cvlt3_brief",
      test_name = "CVLT-3 Brief",
      ci_95 = NA_character_,
      range = NA_character_
    )
  
  # Apply neuro2 ranges if available
  if (neuro2_available && exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))) {
    final <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(final, test_type = "npsych_test")
  }
  
  # Create result text
  final <- final |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      result = ifelse(!is.na(description) & !is.na(range),
                      paste0(description, " was ", range, "."),
                      NA_character_)
    )
  
  # Reorder columns
  rv$final_data <- final |> dplyr::select(any_of(standard_col_order))
  
  showNotification(paste("Processed", nrow(rv$final_data), "scales"), type = "message")
})

output$final_table <- renderDT({
  req(rv$final_data)
  datatable(rv$final_data, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20), rownames = FALSE)
})

output$status <- renderText({
  core_n <- if (!is.null(rv$raw_core)) nrow(rv$raw_core) else 0
  index_n <- if (!is.null(rv$raw_index)) nrow(rv$raw_index) else 0
  proc_n <- if (!is.null(rv$raw_process)) nrow(rv$raw_process) else 0
  final_n <- if (!is.null(rv$final_data)) nrow(rv$final_data) else 0
  
  paste0("Core: ", core_n, " rows | Index: ", index_n, " rows | Process: ", proc_n, " rows | Final: ", final_n, " scales")
})

output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("cvlt3_brief_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    data <- rv$final_data
    if (is.null(data)) data <- data.frame(error = "No data")
    write.csv(data, file, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  }
)
```
